newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ciments Francais sees higher 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: Ciments Francais sees higher 1996 profit.

text.p: French cement company Ciments Francais said on Thursday that its profits for 1996 should show an advance despite a difficult economic climate.

"The economic situation remains depressed in a number of important markets for the group (France, Belgium, Spain) but remains active in North America," the firm said in a statement with its first-half results.
"The pursuit of cost reductions and reduced financial charges will, however, allow an increase in results for the whole of 1996," it said.
Ciments Francais is a unit of Italcementi.
The company posted first-half net attributable profit of 36 million francs versus 51 million a year ago. Operating profit was down 15.1 percent at 748 million.
It posted 1995 net attributable profit of 275 million francs after a 1994 loss of 171 million.
